test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A R Rahman, the famous musician won the 52nd Grammy Award for which of the following songs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jai Ho**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Allah Rakha Rahman **is an **Indian film composer**, **record producer**, **singer**, and, **songwriter **who works **predominantly **in **Indian cinema.**
 
• **Rahman **is now a **Golden Globe® **winner for **"Best Original Soundtrack" **for **SLUMDOG MILLIONAIRE **and has been nominated for **three Oscars **for the film, for best **original score **and **two for best original songs**.
 
• **In 2010**, the **Indian government **awarded him the **Padma Bhushan**, the nation's **third-highest civilian award.**
 
• **Jai Ho" **is a song composed by **A. R. Rahman **for the **2008 **film **Slumdog Millionaire.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rubaroo **song is **composed by A.R. Rahman **in **2005 **for the movie named **"Rang De Basanti".**
 
• **Vande Mataram **is **produced **by **A. R. Rahmaan in 1997.**
